reviewNote: Drafted by Claude from the chart for faculty review. Not validated teaching content.
summary: TKA under spinal in a long term RA patient with documented atlantoaxial instability (ADI 6 mm on flexion) nobody carried forward, mouth opening 28 mm, chronic prednisone skipped this morning, and etanercept taken 3 days ago against the rheumatology plan.

asa.rationale: Erosive RA on chronic steroids and two immunosuppressants, cervical instability, difficult airway features.

decision.recommendation: discuss a short delay; airway and steroid plans are required either way
decision.rationale: Etanercept on 10/24 puts surgery at peak drug effect (plan was to skip that dose so surgery falls in week 2). Surgeon and rheumatology should weigh PJI risk and likely move the case about a week. If proceeding: spinal with neck protection, a C-spine safe airway backup, and her usual prednisone dose.

redFlags.evidence: C-spine flexion films 06/2025: ADI 6 mm on flexion, dens erosion; rheumatology letter asked to note it; PAT note only says neck ROM decreased.
redFlags.implication: Neck flexion (laryngoscopy, sitting spinal positioning, transfers) can compress the cord.
redFlags.action: Neutral neck with in line stabilization, fiberoptic or VL plan if airway is needed, careful spinal positioning, document neuro baseline.

redFlags.finding: Limited mouth opening with MP III
redFlags.evidence: Dental: interincisal opening 28 to 29 mm (TMJ RA); Mallampati III; prior GA with a week of sore throat.
redFlags.implication: Difficult airway if spinal fails or conversion to GA is needed.
redFlags.action: Awake fiberoptic setup ready as backup.

redFlags.evidence: Prednisone 7.5 mg daily since 2008; PAT phone call told her to hold all meds but omeprazole; rheum said continue DOS.
redFlags.implication: Risk of adrenal insufficiency and hypotension.
redFlags.action: Give her usual glucocorticoid dose now (or IV hydrocortisone equivalent); stress dosing per institutional practice.

redFlags.evidence: Patient injected 10/24 for a flare (portal question unanswered); plan was last dose 10/17.
redFlags.action: Surgeon and rheumatology decision on delaying about one week.

redFlags.finding: Fragile steroid skin and adhesive allergy
redFlags.evidence: Thin skin, ecchymoses, paper tape only.

planItems.item: Spinal with neck kept neutral; adductor canal block
Fiberoptic or VL backup with in line stabilization
Cefazolin 2 g within 60 min of incision; TXA 1 g
